pages.actions: none; official HTTPS entry links only

outputs: six read-only pages (overview, courses, resources, calendar, library, health); static HTML/CSS/JS only, no build chain, no external CDN, remote font or analytics service

every card shows display.state/display.message/display.next_step plus source time, live/snapshot/history freshness and completeness; EMPTY, LOGIN_REQUIRED, LIMITED, ERROR, NEEDS_INPUT and NOT_ENABLED use distinct labels and tones
overview loads each card independently: one failed, cancelled or timed-out source does not blank the other cards; a page-level cancel button aborts the in-flight read
courses filters semester, role/type and keyword locally after one registered read; a course row can open the resource page with its course_id

resources filters semester, course_id, type and keyword; selection is keyed by stable_resource_uid and survives page appends and ordinary navigation; changing any filter invalidates the old generation, selection, items and cursor, and an in-flight older page can never populate the new filter; export scope is visible and no download/export is performed

calendar switches timeline/list without a second request; date-level, exact time, overdue, conflicts, undated and completed are separate; a missing school calendar/period table shows the original cycle and an explicit limitation, never a fabricated time
library/appointment pages show existing loans, library reservations and sports orders with official HTTPS entries; no booking, cancel, renew, payment or submit control exists
health page shows implementation_state, runtime_availability, evidence_level and checked_at, and states that local reads do not prove campus availability
all dynamic text uses textContent; links must be https://*.tsinghua.edu.cn without CAS/SSO/login/ticket parameters and are rendered with rel=noopener noreferrer and referrerpolicy=no-referrer
CSP-compatible static shell: no inline script/style/event handler; relative asset URLs with crossorigin=anonymous so same-origin subresources use the CORS mode the 6.2 server allows

only GET requests to /api/v1 routes; no localStorage, sessionStorage, IndexedDB, service worker or bootstrap token in a URL; a 401 or unreachable service wipes all in-memory cards, source lists and selections before showing the notice
a read repeated within the frozen 10-second refresh window reuses the in-memory result and says so; refresh is disabled while a read is pending; no background polling or model request

77 module tests: static asset contract, pure model functions in Chromium, real LocalApiServer + synthetic facade browser flows, CSP, no external network, no write calls, fault injection, keyboard, narrow screen, session expiry, concurrent filter/load-more, navigation state, failure retry, timeout, timezone and encoded-ticket regressions

boundaries: CLI reachability is closed: `src/thu_assistant/__main__.py` imports `web_assets` and passes `static_dir=web_assets.static_dir()` at both `--check` and serve construction sites. `test_dashboard_wires_the_web_assets_static_dir` verifies both calls, and `test_dashboard_prints_the_board_before_it_blocks` fetches `/` and `/assets/app.css` from the real CLI server and gets 200. This touched 6.1-owned code at the owners request to finish the 7.1 audit; the integration owner should review the small wiring diff.

Packaging reachability is closed: `pyproject.toml` package-data includes `web_assets/*.html`, `web_assets/assets/*.css` and `web_assets/assets/*.js`; `MANIFEST.in` recurses the same folder. `test_wheel_is_the_complete_layout_with_licenses_and_entry_points` and `test_sdist_contains_the_sources_needed_to_rebuild_the_bundles` assert the built artifacts contain index.html and app.css. This touched 6.3-owned metadata at the owners request; the integration owner should review the pattern change.

Type filtering is client-side over the loaded pages: the frozen /resources query has no kind parameter, so a type with no match on page 1 says "current loaded range" and keeps load more visible instead of claiming the source has none. Server-side kind filtering remains 4.2/8.1 contract work.

The 6.2 server allows Sec-Fetch-Mode navigate/cors/same-origin and rejects no-cors; Chromium sends cors for <script crossorigin>/<link crossorigin>, which makes the shell work. Firefox/Safari must be checked by 7.2; if they still send no-cors for same-origin static assets, 6.2 must allow same-origin no-cors on the static route without weakening the cross-site refusal.

/resources requires a semester and the 4.2 index has no default; the dashboard asks the user (or offers manual entry when the semester list is unavailable) and never returns an empty success for a missing semester.

Calendar buckets are computed from the loaded items; `conflicts` comes from the API. The API's `views` lists are not used to replace the current page, and a next_cursor adds a 'more pages' limitation instead of pretending the first page is the whole agenda.
Resource selection only defines the export scope shown on the page; no download, export, booking, cancellation, renewal, submission, payment or key action is performed by the dashboard.

Grades, raw sensitive details, credentials and write controls are deliberately absent; where they are needed the user is pointed to the existing controlled MCP/CLI flows and their minimal field projection.

The 10-second reuse is an in-memory page cache mirroring refresh_min_seconds; closing the page, losing the session or losing the service clears it. Nothing is persisted across processes, accounts or browsers.
Browser tests skip with a platform reason when Playwright or Chromium is unavailable; static and pure-model tests still run.
Request ids are shown for support; no account id, cookie, token, member value or user directory is rendered.
All verification is synthetic and loopback-only; no real campus, model, browser write or payment call was made, and passing tests do not raise the evidence level of any real campus transaction.
